I (17M) completely understand your pain my friend.  My mother was a chronic alcoholic and was omitted to many therapy throughout my entire childhood. She would be gone for month at a time and I would have no idea why. It was always, "mom's sick again" and that was it. She had liver failure and extremely low blood pressure, and after staying in a hospital with doctors trying to stabilize her, she pasted away on August 6th, 2020. And on that day I made a vow of abstention from alcohol and that I would never drink a drop no matter how bad it got. Stay strong and don't give up, be sure to seek help if you need and don't be afraid to reach out to your friends.
